In [[186 BBY/Legends|186 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]'' establishes that [[Oppo Rancisis/Legends|Oppo Rancisis]] was 174 [[Standard year/Legends|years]] old at the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]] and that [[Gender/Legends|he]] was twenty when [[Oppo Rancisis's sister|his sister]] was [[Death/Legends|killed]] on [[Ratamesh]]. Since ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the Battle of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], the events on Ratamesh must have occurred in [[186 BBY/Legends|186 BBY]].</ref> agitators '''stormed''' the [[Thisspias alcazar]] on the astronomical object [[Ratamesh]], where they [[Death/Legends|killed]] the [[Oppo Rancisis's sister|reigning]] [[Blood Monarch/Legends|Blood Monarch]] of<ref name="PotJS">''[[Power of the Jedi Sourcebook]]''</ref> the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="NEGAS">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref> [[Thisspias/Legends|Thisspias]].<ref name="PotJS" />
